deviations.what: Stale saves are detected with a server-stamped revision counter, not version: the stored workflow document carries 'revision' metadata outside the Workflow model, bumped by the server on every save; PUT /workflows/{id} sends the expected revision in a body field (expected_revision) and gets 409 naming the current revision on a mismatch or when it is missing. version, rule pins, import/export comparison and both trust digests are unchanged; o13 and h34 read 'revision' for 'version'
deviations.reason: Nothing bumps a workflow's version today (an ordinary model field the client sends; every committed workflow is still version 1), so an expected-version check protects nothing; version is also a rule-pinnable field the engine compares (engine/runs.py:1029) and import writes the bundle's version, so bumping it would break pins and let import reset it

deviations.what: The paragraph reads one sentence per line with no colon after a lead-in: the step's text follows the lead-in with its first letter lowercased (all-caps and mixed-case first words such as PR, GitGuardian, EPUB kept); plain consecutive steps join one sentence with '; then' (with or without a shared condition); a new sentence starts at siblings ('At the same time'), a join ('Once both are done'), a condition change, a loop, a wait or a retry; a loop body continues the loop's sentence with '; each time,'; waits, retries and loop bounds become trailing clauses after the text. A missing description is stood in for by the step's name, else a generic line from the d19 vocabulary, marked as not written yet (italic/muted in the editor, [ ] in the CLI), and stays inside its group. The Then side says what happens directly: 'Where the chain ends here, it updates the chain's status comment on GitHub (as github-app).' / 'If it fails, it updates that comment with the failure.' The editor's description hint asks authors to start with a verb
deviations.reason: Operator, 2026-10-18, reviewing the paragraph: easier to read with a new line after each period and fewer ':'; use the step name (else a generic line) for a missing description; status comment option C
